Not reproduced — The reported fixed Parik24 promotional banner could not be reproduced:⁠ the reported page loads fine in the reporter's own filter profile (both Ukrainian and Russian locales) and in an unfiltered control, and full-page vision plus DOM inspection find no fixed/promo overlay or any banner-like element, only an already-blocked ad rotator producing empty zones. Recommend closing without a rule.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

The run instruction states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not another anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing report, so rule generation was open (allow_rule_generation). No rule of the repository policy as stated in the run instruction blocks the fix; the close recommendation rests on reproduction evidence, not on a policy gate.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.youtube.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F) ### Comment > **Problem: YouTube playlist repeat switches off when AdGuard is enabled.** > > For approximately four months, YouTube's playlist repeat function has stopped working correctly in Google Chrome. > > When I enable repeat, it switches off when the next video starts. comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On note.com the reported "広告" is a shopping/affiliate product card (Amazon Japan, with Sponsored-Products link parameters) rendered inside the article body by note.com's own external-article embed widget; no filter rule covered it, so a cosmetic rule hiding the figure that carries `.external-article-widget--type_shopping` was written. It validated in the AdGuard CLI proxy:⁠ the card is hidden after the rule, page integrity is intact, with no residue and no remaining instances. ## Rule `note.com##figure[name][id]:has(.external-article-widget--type_shopping)` ## Policy rationale The run instruction closes only site-owned advertising, paywalls and anti-adblock walls; this element is a third-party Amazon affiliate/shopping embed with sponsored-ad link parameters inside the article, not the site's ad inventory, and it is not a paywall or an anti-adblock wall. The repository already blocks note.com article affiliate figures (note.com,note.jp#⁠#⁠figure[⁠name]⁠[⁠id]⁠ ⁠> a[⁠href^="https:⁠//px.a8.net/svt/ejp"]⁠ ⁠> img[⁠width="300"]⁠[⁠height="250"]⁠ in JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt), so this class of note.com affiliate embed is treated as blockable. ## Place in the list [JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6a80bb0e6c5d777370140a6f305e5c8e06425bf4/JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 1388](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6a80bb0e6c5d777370140a6f305e5c8e06425bf4/JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1388). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44013142021 Automated analysis against filters at `6a80bb0`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — With the reporter's exact 13-filter selection loaded in the prepared extension, r4.rudub.world/browse.php loads fully intact — readable Cyrillic nav (Новинки, Сериалы, Дубляж, Регистрация, Вход), the "В эфире:⁠ Укрытие. 3 сезон" hero artwork, all first-party CSS/fonts/images at 200 and no hidden or empty content — so the garbled text and missing hero of the reporter's screenshot do not reproduce. Only trackers (gtag, Yandex Metrika, Yadro counter) are blocked, by existing Tracking Protection rules, so no rule change is needed.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy lists no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not first-party advertising, not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not an anti-adblock wall at all, and not a scam/phishing page, so rule generation is open and the report is judged on reproduction evidence. The agent never closes an issue; this outcome only recommends closing because the reported defect is absent on the loaded reported page with the reporter's own filter selection.

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Anti Adblock Script) [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/faa-ground-stop-canceled-flights-travelers-what-we-know/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cbsnews.com%2Fnews%2Ffaa-ground-stop-canceled-flights-travelers-what-we-know%2F) ### Comment > ### Issue Description > Anti-adblock wall on `cbsnews.com` via Admiral First-Party Proxy. > > * **A/B Test Behavior:** Clean/Incognito sessions are served an inescapable hard wall with no dismiss link and page scrolling locked (`overflow: hidden`). Some regular sessions occasionally receive a variant with a delayed *"I'll fix it next time"* dismiss button. > * **Consent Requirement:** Only triggers after OneTrust (`cbsoptanon`) allows targeting/advertising cookies (`cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`). > > ### Proxied Admiral Script URLs Observed > * `https://silkyslumber.com/static/kmxtcpfvq/q1zxupa.js` > * `https://topicspin.com/static/k6vi91qgp/siqqoqasp4mu874ckh6569s5n2uum.js` > > ### Inline Bootstrap & Obfuscation Details > * Admiral's inline loader is wrapped in `loadAdmiralScript()` and invoked asynchronously inside `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` $\rightarrow$ `cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`. > * Because `loadAdmiralScript()` runs asynchronously after `document.currentScript` is `null`, inline scriptlets hooking `document.createElement` do not catch it. > * Evades generic Admiral signatures by aliasing `decodeURI` (`D(D(Y))`) and double-encoding `'admiral'` (`%25%36%31%64m%25%36%39%25%37%32%2561%6C`). > * Static Admiral Property ID in inline script: `QS01RDlDQzI1QTgyQ0FFMzUwNTQ5RkMwQUMtMg` > > ### Suggested / Verified Fix > Aborting synchronously when `loadAdmiralScript` is registered with `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` blocks Admiral before any proxied scripts are fetched: > ```adblock > cbsnews.com#%#//scriptlet('abort-current-inline-script', 'cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady', 'loadAdmiralScript') > ``` ``` Username: @SpoiledSneeze ``` ### Screenshots
